    AI Overview
    Gonzaga University is a private, Jesuit, Catholic university located in Spokane, Washington. The 152-acre campus is situated along the Spokane River, just a short walk north of the city’s downtown urban core. Spokane is in eastern Washington, known as the largest metropolitan area between Seattle and Minneapolis. 
    Key Details About the Location: 
    • Address: 502 East Boone Avenue, Spokane, Washington 99258.
    • Setting: Urban setting with a mix of historic brick buildings and modern facilities, such as the Bollier Center for Science & Engineering.
    • Surroundings:
      Located near the Spokane River, offering access to urban amenities (dining, shopping) and natural beauty, including lakes and mountains.

    Is Gonzaga a religious university?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes,
    Gonzaga University is a private Roman Catholic, Jesuit institution located in Spokane, Washington. While rooted in Catholic, Jesuit, and humanistic traditions—focusing on educating the whole person (mind and heart)—it is inclusive, welcoming students of all faiths and backgrounds, and does not require religious adherence. 
    Key Aspects of Gonzaga's Religious Identity: 
    • Jesuit Tradition: The school is run in the Jesuit tradition, emphasizing intellectual pursuit, social justice, and service to others.
    • Inclusive Environment: Approximately 41% of students are Catholic, but students from all religious, non-religious, or spiritual backgrounds are welcome.
    • Academic Curriculum:
      The core curriculum includes religious studies and philosophy, though students are not forced to follow a particular faith.
    • Campus Ministry: The school provides resources for various faiths, including a chapel, and hosts religious events like Masses, alongside support for non-denominational services. 
    Although it is a religious institution, many students describe the campus atmosphere as welcoming rather than dogmatic.

      Description

      Gonzaga University is a private Jesuit university in Spokane, Washington, United States. It is accredited by the Northwest Commission on Colleges and Universities. Founded in 1887 by Joseph Cataldo, a Sicilian-born priest and Jesuit missionary, the university is named after the young Jesuit saint Aloysius Gonzaga. Wikipedia
